name: Zeda Limited
summary: Zeda Limited, established in 1967 and headquartered in Kempton Park, South Africa, offers comprehensive mobility solutions throughout South Africa and various other Sub-Saharan African nations. The company operates primarily through its Car Rental and Vehicle Leasing divisions. The Car Rental division delivers short-term rental and subscription services to a diverse clientele, including individuals, business travelers, corporate entities, and government agencies, predominantly under the renowned Avis and Budget brands. This segment also supplies replacement vehicles to partner insurance companies and provides a range of supplementary products like child safety seats, GPS devices, bicycle racks, and specialized insurance policies. The Vehicle Leasing division specializes in offering long-term vehicle solutions, encompassing motorcycles and heavy commercial vehicles, to corporations, small businesses, and government organizations. This segment further enhances its offerings with value-added services such as telematics, intelligent fuel and accident management, roadside assistance, insurance, and bespoke maintenance plans and managed maintenance services.
